messages:
lena: Quick thread: rollout timeline follow-up. Key things to nail before the crit: (1) add patterned overlay for canary weight so colorblind users can read heatmap; (2) timeline scrubber keyboard affordances; (3) soften rollback modal copy to reduce alarm. Sketch: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/rollout-hatch (internal).
rob: Pattern sounds good. Suggest diagonal hatch + opacity so it layers with existing color. For numeric clarity add a small inline percentage badge on the scrubber thumb. Example: '45%'.
priya: Accessibility checklist: hatch is great but ensure interplay with contrast. Use at least 3:1 contrast between hatch foreground and background per WCAG non-text UI guidance. Also provide an option to switch to 'pattern only' mode for grayscale prints.
ux-researcher: From sessions, people misread the timeline colors when multiple variants overlap. Pattern per-variant (diagonal, dot, cross) helped in usability tests. Keep patterns subtle when weight <10% so they don't clutter.
a11y-bot: A11y notes: the scrubber must expose current snapshot index via aria-valuenow and a descriptive aria-label like 'Timeline scrubber, snapshot 7 of 24, Mar 23 15:04'. Add aria-live="polite" region for snapshot changes so screen readers announce new snapshot summaries.
rob: Keyboard proposal: focus on scrubber -> left/right moves +/-1 snapshot, shift+arrow jumps 5, pageup/pagedown jump to prev/next day, home/end go to start/end. Also support numeric entry if user types a number while focused: jumps to that snapshot id.
priya: For tooltips: ensure they appear on focus as well as hover. Use role="tooltip" and aria-describedby from the scrubber thumb. Tooltips must include localized short timestamp and commit hash.
lena: Rollback modal copy: current 'Confirm rollback' is terse and scary. Proposed: title 'Rollback to v1.11.4' body 'This will redirect live traffic immediately to v1.11.4. Consider canary first to validate.' Primary CTA: 'Rollback and Route Traffic' secondary 'Cancel'. Also add a small link 'What happens on rollback?' that opens docs.
ux-researcher: Users liked a 3-second delay on destructive primary actions in tests; it reduced accidental clicks. Could we add a small countdown before the CTA becomes active?
rob: Agree. Implementation note: keep the countdown accessible: show the remaining seconds in the aria-label and disable until it hits 0. e.g. aria-disabled="true" and update aria-label each second.
a11y-bot: Motion/anim note: if the timeline auto-plays snapshots, honor prefers-reduced-motion and provide a per-user toggle to disable auto-advance. Auto-play should not move keyboard focus.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: event: scrubber-focused user=rob ts=1776543278
priya: Design to dev handoff items: pattern assets (SVGs), aria attributes list, tooltip copy, keyboard mapping doc. I'll draft the ARIA checklist and contrast ratios.
lena: Great. Rob to mock the hatch densities and thumb badge, Priya to finalize ARIA checklist, UX-researcher to run 2 quick hallway tests on Wed. We'll review in crit Fri 11. Thanks everyone!
